## Defects (fix at the root, regression test for each one you can reproduce offline)
1. **CTA button pasted, upscaled, blurry, with a grey/red rim — and marked `pass`.** `stride-after/ig-feed-11.png`, `ig-story-916.png`, `fb-link.png`: the "Shop now" button is the source cut scaled up ~3x (blurry text), far too large (in ig-feed-11 it is ~800px wide on a 1080 canvas; in the source it is a small button), surrounded by a grey/reddish rectangle of source pixels, and its top border is cut off by that rectangle. Root-cause why the panel falls back to paste instead of rebuild for this simple flat button, and why it is sized so large. Required: a simple flat CTA is **rebuilt** (sampled fill, border, crisp re-rendered text), sized relative to the source button × the layout scale with a sane cap (a CTA is never wider than ~45% of the canvas width in square/portrait, never taller than ~9% of the canvas height). When a paste is truly unavoidable: never upscale a pasted cut by more than 1.25x (rebuild or keep size instead), and the cut must be inset to the button's own edge — no surrounding plate pixels. Add deterministic checks: `panel_upscaled` (pasted cut scaled > 1.25x) and `panel_rim` (a band of non-plate, non-panel colour around the panel) → fail.
2. **Reading order reversed.** In `stride-after/ig-feed-11.png`, `ig-feed-45.png` and `ig-story-916.png` the subtext "The new Aero 2" is placed **above** the headline "Run lighter."; in `fb-link.png` the price `$129` is jammed between the logo and the headline. The source order is logo → headline → subtext → price → CTA. Find which session-18 change (column snap / group stacking / shrink-to-fit) or older planner rule reorders them, and fix it: the vertical order of the text group must follow the source order (by role and source y), with consistent spacing. Add a deterministic check `reading_order` (output vertical order of headline/subtext/price/CTA differs from the source) → fail.
3. **Vertical / story sizes don't use the canvas.** All `ig-story-916` outputs (STRIDE, Hebrew poster, LUMA, NORTHBEAN) cram the whole ad into a small area and leave 40–60% of the canvas empty or as plain background; product and text are tiny (NORTHBEAN story: cans ~20% of the width; LUMA story: everything in the middle third; Hebrew story: poster in the top half, bottom half empty tiles; STRIDE story: tiny shoe, orphaned `$129` mid-canvas). Session 18 left this as "planner gap". Fix the portrait_stack / 9:16 planning: the product (hero) scales up to fill a large share of the canvas (target ≥ ~35–45% of the canvas height for a product photo, respecting the safe zones of stories: top ~14% and bottom ~20% kept clear of text/CTA), the text group sits in a clear band with readable size (headline height ≥ ~4% of canvas height), CTA and price stay with the text group, and no empty band > 20% of the canvas height outside the safe zones. Make `empty_band` / a new `hero_too_small` check catch this so a cramped story can't be `pass`.
4. **Headline over a background edge.** `stride-after/ig-story-916.png`: "Run lighter." sits right on the ledge/shelf line of the plate. Text must not straddle a strong horizontal edge of the plate (check the plate's edge map under each text box; move the text group or report `text_over_edge` → needs_review).
5. **Orphaned price.** `stride-after/ig-story-916.png` `$129` alone mid-canvas; `luma-after/ig-feed-11.png` `$42` stranded on the left beside the product. The price belongs to the text/offer group in every layout family (session 18 says offer-group cohesion only runs on landscape — make it run everywhere).
6. **Hebrew poster leftovers.** `hebrew-after/yt-thumb.png` (and fb-link) show ghost remnants of the original logo/text at the bottom of the plate; the yellow tagline renders yellow-on-cream with no backing (illegible). Text colour for re-rendered non-panel text must pass a contrast check against the plate under it — if the source text had a backing shape (brush/box), keep the backing; otherwise pick the source's contrasting colour. Plate remnants under/near where the source logo/text were must be cleaned (session 18's row-extension erase made streaks on gradients — use a proper inpaint/plate regen for those regions instead).
7. **Statuses.** After your fixes, re-check every output at full size. Anything with a visible defect from this list must not be `pass`. Session 18 marked STRIDE ig-feed-11 and ig-story-916 `passed/passed` while they had defects 1–5 — that must be impossible now.

Do not regress what session 18 fixed: CTA text not clipped, no ghost bar under the button, shared alignment edge, logo source pixels without recolouring, Hebrew "5$ / בלבד" group together.
